Hi Sarah — great to hear the demo was useful. I've attached a draft SOW and our pricing workbook that includes both marginal and blended views for a few committed shapes.

Quick summary of what we recommend for a 12-month, ~1.2B token commit:
- 3 breakpoints by cumulative tokens: 0-500M, 500M-2B, >2B
- Marginal per-token: $0.00090 | $0.00060 | $0.00045

- Option: a capped blended guarantee for the first 6 months to help your forecasting (we can show the true-up at year end)

I've copied our pricing lead internally to confirm flexibility on the middle tier and to propose an alternate hybrid (marginal + small blended floor) if procurement prefers a single-line effective rate on invoices.

Kimberly — quick thoughts:

- Marginal sequence is fine; it aligns to cost-per-token tapering as volume increases. For the middle tier (500M-2B) I'd be comfortable moving to $0.00055 if we attach a 3-month ramp commitment (protects against front-loaded spike then drop).
- Hybrid proposal: charge marginal per token but include an invoice-level line that reports an "estimated blended rate" capped at $0.00070 for the first 6 months. Year-end true-up reconciles to actual marginal billed. That gives finance a single AR line while keeping our marginal economics intact.
- Guardrails: minimum monthly commitment band (e.g., 35% of monthly plan) for the first 90 days, and a single true-up at anniversary (no monthly clawbacks). If they underuse materially (<70% of commit over rolling quarter), we reserve right to reprice subsequent quarters.

I'll draft language and numbers for the external email.

—Rishi
VP, Pricing & GTM Economics

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. After internal alignment we can offer the following and are happy to iterate:

Proposal (12-month commit, ~1.2B expected):
- Breakpoints (cumulative): 0–500M | 500M–2B | >2B
- Marginal per-token rates: $0.00090 | $0.00055 (negotiated) | $0.00045
- For your 1.2B shape the weighted (marginal) effective rate = $0.00069/token
- Hybrid invoice option: we will bill marginally but provide an "estimated blended rate" line item capped at $0.00070/token for the first six months to support your forecasting. We will perform a single year-end true-up to reconcile to actual marginal charges.
- Guardrails: 35% minimum expected monthly consumption for the first 90 days; if rolling-quarter usage <70% of committed shape we can discuss a mid-year repricing. No monthly clawbacks — single annual true-up only.

Attachments: AcmeHealth_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing-model.xlsx (I've highlighted the scenario tabs). If this looks good, I can send a DocuSign for the SOW and an updated invoice example showing the capped blended line.
